From the start Brad made sure to listen to what we wanted and designed our back porch and pool perfectly! reviews.text:
This was our second build with Venture, and the experience was just as solid as the first. Mark understood my wife’s vision from the start and turned it into a design that needed no change orders. He added thoughtful details we wouldn’t have considered, all while keeping the look and feel she wanted.

John managed the project with real ownership—communicating early, addressing issues before they became problems, and keeping everything on track.

The finished backyard is exactly what we hoped for, and the quality shows in every detail. We love spending our time out there, and we’re very pleased with the outcome. We would absolutely work with Mark and John again.
reviews.author: Greg Gannaway

reviews.text:
We highly recommend Venture Custom Pools. They were able to transform my backyard from an empty space with grass to an oasis. Our great experience started in the design phase. Mark from design, listened to our ideas. He was able to show us what our back would look like when completed. We were impressed and excited.
As with any construction, delays and issues can happen. Sometimes we cannot control it. However, Brett (construction manager), Amanda (office) and Angelica (office) kept us on track to finish our backyard within the timeline proposed.
Kudos to Brett. He is amazing!!! He was on top of every single step. He kept us informed of all steps and made sure that the construction was done right at the first time. He also made sure that the outcome was what we were expecting.
We appreciate you all.

reviews.text:
The pool that Venture custom built for us was splendid. Make sure you do your own research when building a pool! Know what components and features you want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). We went with Venture Custom Pools after interviewing about 5 different builders.

Below is a breakdown of how we selected our pool builder.

In order:

1. Picked a pool company that was willing to work with our budget, had a good track record of building pools (# of pools built the past 2-3 years. Had good sales/revenue records to prove that they build pools -- had reliable/stable trade-crews w/ good reputation).

- Venture checked that box.

2. Picked a pool company that had good warranties (not just the pool equipment but craftsmanship warranties as well so they follow-up and fix/address problematic tiles, coping, defects, etc.)

- Venture checked that box and has addressed issues (nothing ever goes to plan or is perfect..)

3. We cared a lot about customer service (once the contract was signed) so we wanted to make sure we picked a pool company with good communication skills (I asked to make sure our project manager (Thanks Bret!) would update us frequently, be available to answer questions, etc.. throughout the whole process. If I didn't sense the pool company would be transparent and communicative, I moved on to the next pool company (some companies will seem to be responsive until you sign with them).

-Venture assigned Bret who made himself available to us throughout the entire process

4. Know what components and features you want or don't want in a pool or you may get pool builders upselling you on it (this is for inground). Also, stick to your budget and ask what options you have!

-Venture understood what I wanted and what we were looking for (didn't try to upsell us). They made suggestions but my family and I knew where we were going to spend and where we were going to go lower cost on.

Ultimately, what was most important to us was a company that would stand behind their work, team and deliver (not necessarily on-time but close to it). Venture Custom Pools did that.

With any project, there were delays due to weather (rain/hail) and scheduling issues due to backed up clients. My family didn't expect the schedule to go to plan even though Venture said it could be done on a given timeline. While it could've obviously gone better, faster, and efficient, we felt Venture Custom was better than the other builders we interviewed because they were willing to fix issues post-build.

Would we build a pool with them again? The answer is Yes.

If Venture Custom Pools could improve here is what I would suggest employees at Venture Custom Pools focus on.

- Explain all the options of what is possible given the budget
- Explain the soil injections (pool shell/decking)
- Ask how we want our pool to be cleaned (robot, suction-wall, auto cleaning features)
- Explain why sand or cartridge is better
- Explain salt vs. chlorine
- Explain auto-fill water vs. manual fill
- Explain how important positioning/placement of pool lights are, not just about led strength
- Explain drain holes and its locations and why
- Explain why one would need 1 or 2 skimmers
- Be proactive in scheduling and informing clients of when trades are scheduled and when it has been re-scheduled for a later date.

In general, I enjoyed my pool building experience. If you're looking for a company that will work with you to get what you want done pick Venture Custom Pools over the many out here in the DFW area.

Remember, the cost of building a pool is typically more than an expensive luxury vehicle (the one we built was our second largest purchase -- second to our home).

Pick a high-quality pool builder like Venture Custom Pools that have good crews (trades) and will support and fix issues that arise...(because there will be!).
reviews.author: Jeffrey Ee

reviews.author: Bridgett Green

reviews.text:
I highly recommend considering Venture Custom Pool for your pool construction needs. I recently had my pool built by them, and the construction took place from October 2023 to February 2024. Mark Leuthold, the Senior Construction Consultant, did an exceptional job in meeting our requirements while staying within a reasonable budget. He presented an excellent initial design proposal based on our initial discussions and was very accommodating in making modifications to suit our preferences. The ability to view a virtual image of the proposed pool was incredibly convenient and allowed us to visualize the final outcome before any work began. Mark provided valuable suggestions and guidance based on his extensive knowledge and experience, which was immensely helpful throughout the process.
Following the finalization of the design, we were introduced to Buddy Phillips, the Construction Manager, who efficiently organized the construction timeline. Buddy was proactive in keeping us informed of any delays or issues that arose during the construction phase. Whenever we had questions, Buddy promptly provided comprehensive answers, ensuring we remained fully informed throughout the project. Additionally, as we had to travel internationally during the construction period, Buddy was accommodating in rescheduling the construction activities to ensure we could observe crucial stages of the process. Even after the construction was finished, Buddy continued to offer strong support by addressing our inquiries and attending to post-construction requirements. He dedicated considerable time to thoroughly explain the operation instructions for the pool and promptly responded to any questions we had, spending hours ensuring we were fully informed.
Overall, our experience with Venture Custom Pool, Mark, and Buddy exceeded our expectations, and we are thrilled with the final result of our pool.
reviews.author: Jeung Ki Yoo
